notes.title: We Are Live!
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that Rascals is finally finished and available for purchase.  The end result has shifted a bit from our vision, improving along the way, and we are left with the cutest little gem of a game.  It's fun, intriguing, pretty and quite complex.  Now it's time to leave it over to you in the hope that you will have as much fun playing it as we had creating it.
